_comment: Single source of truth for lanes. scripts/lanes.py reads this. Edit here, not in the scripts.

generator.notes: Already running in the main checkout. Do not create a worktree; merge it first.

stats.stubs: No stubs needed: build on contracts/stats_ref.py and examples. Use out/match_*.jsonl from the generator for benchmarks once it is merged; until then use contracts/examples/valid/match_stream.jsonl.

verifier.stubs: Recompute metrics with contracts/stats_ref.py directly, never by importing services/stats. Judge calls go through receipts_common.llm with replay cassettes. Test on contracts/examples/eval.

agents.stubs: Until the real Verifier merges, use a stub that answers on the bus using contracts/validate.check_claims and always-verify semantics for valid claims. Until the real stats engine merges, compute snapshots with contracts/stats_ref.py behind a small adapter you delete later.

overlay.stubs: Work from contracts/examples/valid (claims, verdicts, snapshots, profiles, overlays.jsonl). The compiler must regenerate overlays.jsonl semantically.

evals.stubs: Use a fake Verifier with a known confusion matrix to test the harness. Port the operators from contracts/tools/make_example_evalset.py. Never modify contracts/.

web.stubs: Build against contracts/examples/valid fixtures served by a fixture mode in services/api. This lane also owns the FastAPI service (SSE relay, replay control, demo endpoints).

azure.stubs: Spec 07 task 1 (access, region, quota) needs a human with the subscription. Do everything else offline: Bicep builds without credentials, and the conformance suite for the Azure bus and store skips when credentials are absent.

integration.notes: Starts after wave 1 lanes are merged. Create its worktree manually with: python scripts/lanes.py create integration --force
